text.p: ING-Barings said Polish Bradys were attractive at current levels in its Fixed-Income Strategy Quarterly View and Asset Allocation Emerging Markets Research dated April 1997.
"Poland Brady's have underperformed the EMBI+ year to date, and at current levels are attrractive for both their capital appreciation potential and status as good defensive assets," the report said.
ING-Barings said Poland's underperformance was likely to be reversed in late April or May if Standard & Poors or Moody's upgrade the contry's rating as a result of upcoming reviews.
It said that the short-term trading range was likely to be 150-175 basis points in the PDI, 200-225 pb in the Discount, and 175-200 bp in the Par.
